<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Zebra Trades — Wall Media Centres & Fireplaces</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Montserrat:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
:root{
  --black:#0d0d0d;
  --charcoal:#1a1a1a;
  --dark:#222;
  --mid:#888;
  --border:#ddd;
  --light:#f5f5f5;
  --off:#fafafa;
  --white:#fff;
  --orange:#e8622a;
  --orange-h:#d45520;
}
body{font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;color:var(--dark);background:var(--white);overflow-x:hidden;font-size:13px;}

/* ── UTILITY BAR ── */
.util-bar{background:var(--black);color:#999;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0 40px;height:34px;}
.util-bar a{color:#bbb;text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s;}
.util-bar a:hover{color:#fff;}
.util-right{display:flex;gap:20px;}

/* ── HEADER ── */
header{background:var(--white);border-bottom:1px solid #e8e8e8;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:900;box-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.06);}
.header-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;height:76px;padding:0 40px;gap:40px;}
.logo-area img{height:50px;width:auto;display:block;}
.main-nav{display:flex;flex:1;justify-content:center;}
.main-nav a{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#555;padding:0 16px;height:76px;line-height:76px;display:block;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;transition:all .2s;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;}
.main-nav a:hover,.main-nav a.active{color:var(--black);border-bottom-color:var(--orange);}
.header-right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;white-space:nowrap;}
.h-phone{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--black);letter-spacing:-.01em;}
.h-email a{font-size:11px;color:var(--orange);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:.04em;}
.h-email a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero{position:relative;height:600px;background:var(--black);overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;}
.hero-bg-wrap{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;}
.hero-scene{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.hero-fire-svg{width:100%;height:100%;}
.hero-gradient{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.88) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.55) 50%,rgba(0,0,0,.2) 100%);}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:0 40px;max-width:640px;}
.hero-tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
.hero-tag::before{content:'';width:30px;height:1px;background:var(--orange);}
.hero-h1{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(2.6rem,4.5vw,4rem);font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px;}
.hero-h1 em{font-style:italic;color:#e8c97a;}
.hero-motto{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.45);margin-bottom:36px;}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.btn-solid{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;border:none;padding:14px 32px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s;}
.btn-solid:hover{background:var(--orange-h);}
.btn-ghost-w{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);padding:14px 32px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
.btn-ghost-w:hover{border-color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
.hero-scroll{position:absolute;bottom:28px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
.hero-scroll span{font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);}
.hero-scroll-line{width:1px;height:40px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(255,255,255,.3),transparent);}

/* ── CATEGORY STRIP ── */
.cat-strip{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);background:var(--black);}
.cat-item{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;}
.cat-item-inner{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:3.5rem;background:var(--charcoal);transition:transform .5s ease;}
.cat-item:hover .cat-item-inner{transform:scale(1.06);}
.cat-item-overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(0,0,0,.8) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.1) 60%,transparent 100%);transition:opacity .3s;}
.cat-item:hover .cat-item-overlay{opacity:.7;}
.cat-item-label{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:20px 22px;width:100%;}
.cat-item-label h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:5px;}
.cat-item-label p{font-size:10px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5);letter-spacing:.06em;}
.cat-arrow{display:block;margin-top:10px;width:24px;height:1px;background:var(--orange);position:relative;transition:width .25s;}
.cat-arrow::after{content:'';position:absolute;right:-1px;top:-3px;border-right:1px solid var(--orange);border-top:1px solid var(--orange);width:6px;height:6px;transform:rotate(45deg);}
.cat-item:hover .cat-arrow{width:38px;}

/* ── SECTION SHELL ── */
.section{padding:60px 40px;}
.section-light{background:var(--off);}
.section-dark{background:var(--charcoal);}
.section-head{margin-bottom:40px;}
.section-head.center{text-align:center;}
.sec-tag{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);margin-bottom:10px;}
.sec-h2{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3vw,2.4rem);font-weight:700;color:var(--black);line-height:1.2;}
.sec-h2-white{color:#fff;}
.sec-sub{margin-top:10px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mid);line-height:1.7;max-width:580px;}
.sec-sub.center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;}

/* ── SHOP TABS ── */
.shop-sticky{position:sticky;top:76px;z-index:800;background:var(--white);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.tab-row{display:flex;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;}
.tab-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.tab-btn{flex-shrink:0;background:none;border:none;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;padding:16px 22px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#aaa;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;white-space:nowrap;}
.tab-btn:hover{color:var(--dark);}
.tab-btn.active{color:var(--black);border-bottom-color:var(--orange);}

/* ── FILTERS ── */
.filter-bar{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;}
.fc{background:none;border:1px solid #ddd;color:#aaa;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:5px 14px;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s;}
.fc:hover{color:var(--dark);border-color:#aaa;}
.fc.active{background:var(--black);color:#fff;border-color:var(--black);}

/* ── SHOP SECTIONS ── */
.shop-sec{display:none;}
.shop-sec.active{display:block;}

/* ── ROOM GRID ── */
.room-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(480px,1fr));gap:2px;background:#ddd;}
.room-card{background:var(--white);overflow:hidden;}
.room-img{aspect-ratio:16/9;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#111;}
.room-img svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;}
.room-badges{position:absolute;top:14px;left:14px;display:flex;gap:6px;z-index:3;}
.rbadge{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px;}
.rb-hot{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;}
.rb-new{background:var(--black);color:#fff;}
.rb-eco{background:#3a6e3a;color:#fff;}
.rb-lux{background:#b8942a;color:#fff;}
.swatches{position:absolute;bottom:14px;right:14px;display:flex;gap:5px;z-index:3;}
.sw{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s;}
.sw:hover{transform:scale(1.45);}
.room-info{padding:24px 26px 16px;}
.rcat{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);margin-bottom:6px;}
.rname{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--black);margin-bottom:8px;}
.rdesc{font-size:12px;color:var(--mid);line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:14px;}
.rfeat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px 12px;}
.rf{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--dark);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:flex-start;}
.rf::before{content:'✓';color:var(--orange);font-size:10px;margin-top:2px;flex-shrink:0;font-weight:700;}
.room-foot{padding:16px 26px 26px;border-top:1px solid #efefef;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.price-col{flex:1;min-width:90px;}
.price-from{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#bbb;margin-bottom:2px;}
.price-val{font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--black);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em;}
.btns-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;flex:2;min-width:190px;}
.btn-buy-room{background:var(--black);color:#fff;border:none;padding:11px 16px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s;text-align:center;}
.btn-buy-room:hover{background:var(--orange);}
.btn-install{background:#fff;color:var(--dark);border:1px solid #ccc;padding:10px 16px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;text-align:center;}
.btn-install:hover{border-color:var(--orange);color:var(--orange);}

/* ── PRODUCT GRID ── */
.prod-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(270px,1fr));gap:2px;background:#ddd;}
.prod-card{background:var(--white);overflow:hidden;transition:box-shadow .22s;}
.prod-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.1);position:relative;z-index:2;}
.prod-thumb{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:#f0f0f0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:4rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.prod-body{padding:16px 18px 12px;}
.pcat{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);margin-bottom:5px;}
.pname{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--black);margin-bottom:7px;line-height:1.2;}
.pdesc{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--mid);line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:10px;}
.specs{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:8px;}
.spec{font-size:10px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 9px;background:var(--light);color:var(--dark);letter-spacing:.03em;border:1px solid #e8e8e8;}
.prod-foot{padding:10px 18px 18px;border-top:1px solid #efefef;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;}
.pprice{font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--black);line-height:1;}
.pprice small{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#bbb;display:block;margin-bottom:2px;}
.btn-add{background:var(--black);color:#fff;border:none;padding:10px 18px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s;}
.btn-add:hover{background:var(--orange);}

/* ── POA ── */
.poa-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(310px,1fr));gap:1.5px;background:#ddd;}
.poa-card{background:var(--white);padding:34px 30px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.poa-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:3px;height:100%;background:var(--orange);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top;transition:transform .3s;}
.poa-card:hover::before{transform:scaleY(1);}
.poa-num{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:4rem;font-weight:700;color:#f0f0f0;line-height:1;position:absolute;top:16px;right:20px;}
.poa-icon{font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:12px;}
.poa-cat{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);margin-bottom:7px;}
.poa-name{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--black);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.25;}
.poa-desc{font-size:12px;color:var(--mid);line-height:1.75;margin-bottom:18px;}
.poa-price{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dark);padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #eee;margin-bottom:16px;}
.btn-enq{background:none;border:1px solid var(--black);color:var(--black);padding:10px 20px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
.btn-enq:hover{background:var(--black);color:#fff;}

/* ── PROMISE STRIP ── */
.promise{background:var(--black);padding:50px 40px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:30px;}
.pr-item{text-align:center;}
.pr-icon{font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:10px;}
.pr-title{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;margin-bottom:7px;}
.pr-text{font-size:12px;color:#666;line-height:1.65;}

/* ── FOOTER ── */
footer{background:#111;}
.foot-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px;padding:50px 40px 36px;}
.foot-logo img{height:44px;width:auto;margin-bottom:12px;filter:brightness(0) invert(.7);}
.foot-motto{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:13px;color:#b8942a;margin-bottom:12px;}
.foot-about{font-size:11.5px;color:#555;line-height:1.75;}
.foot-about a{color:#888;text-decoration:none;transition:color .15s;}
.foot-about a:hover{color:#fff;}
.foot-col-h{font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--orange);margin-bottom:14px;}
.foot-col a{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#555;text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s;}
.foot-col a:hover{color:#fff;}
.foot-bottom{border-top:1px solid #1e1e1e;padding:14px 40px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;font-size:10.5px;color:#444;}

/* ── MODAL ── */
.m-back{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);z-index:9999;place-items:center;padding:20px;}
.m-back.open{display:grid;}
.modal{background:#fff;max-width:500px;width:100%;padding:38px 36px;position:relative;}
.m-close{position:absolute;top:14px;right:16px;background:none;border:none;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;color:#bbb;line-height:1;}
.m-close:hover{color:var(--dark);}
.m-h{font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:1.55rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--black);margin-bottom:6px;}
.m-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--mid);margin-bottom:24px;line-height:1.6;}
.fr{margin-bottom:14px;}
.fr label{display:block;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#aaa;margin-bottom:5px;}
.fr input,.fr textarea,.fr select{width:100%;background:var(--off);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--dark);padding:10px 12px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;outline:none;transition:border-color .2s;-webkit-appearance:none;border-radius:0;}
.fr input:focus,.fr textarea:focus,.fr select:focus{border-color:var(--orange);}
.fr textarea{height:86px;resize:vertical;}
.fr select option{background:#fff;}
.m-submit{width:100%;background:var(--black);color:#fff;border:none;padding:14px;font-family:'Montserrat',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;cursor:pointer;margin-top:6px;transition:background .2s;}
.m-submit:hover{background:var(--orange);}

/* ── TOAST ── */
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;right:24px;background:var(--black);color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.04em;border-left:3px solid var(--orange);z-index:8888;opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);transition:all .25s ease;pointer-events:none;max-width:300px;}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:none;}

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media(max-width:960px){.cat-strip{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}.foot-top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}.hero{height:480px;}}
@media(max-width:640px){.util-bar,.header-right{display:none;}.header-wrap{padding:0 20px;height:64px;}.shop-sticky{top:64px;}.main-nav a{padding:0 10px;font-size:10px;}.cat-strip{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.section{padding:40px 20px;}.room-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}.room-foot{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;}.btns-col{width:100%;}.foot-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:36px 20px 24px;}.foot-bottom{padding:12px 20px;}.hero{height:420px;}.hero-content{padding:0 20px;}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- UTIL BAR -->
<div class="util-bar">
  <span>Specialists in Wall Media Centres &amp; Fireplaces — Nationwide Supply &amp; Installation</span>
  <div class="util-right">
    <a href="tel:07872121425">📞 07872 121 425</a>
    <a href="mailto:info@zebratrades.co.uk">info@zebratrades.co.uk</a>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- HEADER -->
<header>
  <div class="header-wrap">
    <div class="logo-area"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Zebra Trades Wall Media Centres"></div>
    <nav class="main-nav">
      <a class="active" onclick="showTab('room-sets')">Room Sets</a>
      <a onclick="showTab('fires')">Fires Only</a>
      <a onclick="showTab('accessories')">Accessories</a>
      <a onclick="showTab('bespoke')">Bespoke / POA</a>
    </nav>
    <div class="header-right">
      <div class="h-phone">07872 121 425</div>
      <div class="h-email"><a href="mailto:info@zebratrades.co.uk">info@zebratrades.co.uk</a></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- HERO -->
<section class="hero">
  <div class="hero-bg-wrap">
    <div class="hero-scene">
      <svg class="hero-fire-svg" viewBox="0 0 1400 600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice">
        <rect width="1400" height="600" fill="#111"/>
        <!-- Wall unit -->
        <rect x="0" y="340" width="1400" height="260" fill="#181818"/>
        <rect x="0" y="345" width="280" height="252" fill="#1e1e1e"/>
        <rect x="1120" y="345" width="280" height="252" fill="#1e1e1e"/>
        <!-- Centre surround -->
        <rect x="286" y="60" width="828" height="292" rx="4" fill="#1c1c1c"/>
        <rect x="286" y="60" width="828" height="3" fill="#b8942a"/>
        <rect x="286" y="349" width="828" height="3" fill="#b8942a"/>
        <!-- Fire aperture -->
        <rect x="306" y="80" width="788" height="264" rx="2" fill="#0a0808"/>
        <!-- FLAMES -->
        <ellipse cx="560" cy="316" rx="60" ry="52" fill="#8b1a00" opacity=".9"><animate attributeName="ry" values="52;64;44;58;52" dur="2.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></ellipse>
        <ellipse cx="700" cy="288" rx="80" ry="76" fill="#c03010" opacity=".9"><animate attributeName="ry" values="76;92;64;82;76" dur="1.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></ellipse>
        <ellipse cx="840" cy="312" rx="60" ry="50" fill="#8b1a00" opacity=".9"><animate attributeName="ry" values="50;62;42;56;50" dur="2.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></elleze>
        <ellipse cx="700" cy="302" rx="42" ry="58" fill="#e8622a" opacity=".85"><animate attributeName="ry" values="58;70;48;62;58" dur="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></ellipse>
        <ellipse cx="700" cy="318" rx="22" ry="30" fill="#f8a040" opacity=".8"><animate attributeName="ry" values="30;38;24;34;30" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></ellipse>
        <ellipse cx="700" cy="330" rx="10" ry="14" fill="#fee080" opacity=".7"/>
        <!-- Ember glow -->
        <ellipse cx="700" cy="342" rx="160" ry="10" fill="#c03010" opacity=".2"><animate attributeName="opacity" values=".2;.35;.15;.28;.2" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></ellipse>
        <!-- TV panel -->
        <rect x="290" y="28" width="820" height="30" rx="2" fill="#161616"/>
        <rect x="294" y="32" width="812" height="22" rx="1" fill="#0d1520"/>
        <!-- Cabinet details -->

<script>
var kendalImgs = [
  "https://www.firez.co.uk/images/theme-pics/Firez-Stoves----Kendal-Scene.jpg",
  "https://www.firez.co.uk/images/theme-pics/Firez-Stoves---Kendal-Close-up.jpg",
  "https://www.firez.co.uk/images/theme-pics/Firez-Kendal-spec.jpg"
];
var kendalIdx = 0;

function setImg(id, i) {
  kendalIdx = i;
  var img = document.getElementById(id + "-img");
  if (!img) return;
  img.style.opacity = "0";
  setTimeout(function() {
    img.src = kendalImgs[i];
    img.style.opacity = "1";
  }, 200);
  var dots = document.querySelectorAll(".kendal-dot");
  dots.forEach(function(d, j) { d.style.opacity = j === i ? "1" : ".4"; });
}

function nextImg(id) {
  setImg(id, (kendalIdx + 1) % kendalImgs.length);
}
</script>

<!-- TOAST -->
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script>
var tabMap = {
  "room-sets": "sec-room-sets",
  "fires": "sec-fires",
  "accessories": "sec-accessories",
  "bespoke": "sec-bespoke"
};

function showTab(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".shop-sec").forEach(function(s) { s.classList.remove("active"); });
  document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(function(t) { t.classList.remove("active"); });
  document.querySelectorAll(".main-nav a").forEach(function(a) { a.classList.remove("active"); });
  var sec = document.getElementById(tabMap[id]);
  if (sec) sec.classList.add("active");
  var tab = document.getElementById("tab-" + id);
  if (tab) tab.classList.add("active");
}

function scrollShop() {
  var el = document.getElementById("shop-top");
  if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
}

function addCart(n, p) {
  showToast("Added to cart: " + n);
}

function showToast(m) {
  var t = document.getElementById("toast");
  if (!t) return;
  t.textContent = m;
  t.classList.add("show");
  if (t._timer) clearTimeout(t._timer);
  t._timer = setTimeout(function() { t.classList.remove("show"); }, 3200);
}

var modalMessages = {
  bespoke:    ["Bespoke Media Wall Quote",     "Tell us your dimensions and vision."],
  period:     ["Period Fireplace Quote",        "Heritage properties need specialist care."],
  colour:     ["Colour Match Enquiry",          "Share your RAL or Farrow and Ball reference."],
  commercial: ["Commercial and Trade Enquiry",  "Multi-unit pricing and account management."],
  stone:      ["Natural Stone Quote",           "Hand-sourced, priced on specification."],
  alcove:     ["Non-Standard Space Quote",      "Awkward room? We will make it beautiful."],
  survey:     ["Book a Free Home Survey",       "We visit, measure up, no obligation."],
  contact:    ["Contact Zebra Trades",          "We are happy to help with any question."]
};

function openModal(k) {
  var m = modalMessages[k] || ["Enquire Now", "Get in touch with our team."];
  document.getElementById("m-title").textContent = m[0];
  document.getElementById("m-sub").textContent = m[1];
  document.getElementById("m-back").classList.add("open");
}

function closeModal() {
  document.getElementById("m-back").classList.remove("open");
}

function submitForm() {
  closeModal();
  showToast("Enquiry sent! We will be in touch within 1 working day.");
}

document.querySelectorAll(".fc").forEach(function(b) {
  b.addEventListener("click", function() {
    var bar = this.closest(".filter-bar");
    bar.querySelectorAll(".fc").forEach(function(x) { x.classList.remove("active"); });
    this.classList.add("active");
  });
});

var modalBack = document.getElementById("m-back");
if (modalBack) {
  modalBack.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) closeModal();
  });
}
</script>
